# MID PENN BANK DONATES $60,000 TO PA BREAST CANCER COALITION


Posted on Oct 7th, 2026


Millersburg, Pa., October 7, 2026 — Mid Penn Bank (the “Bank”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Mid Penn Bancorp, Inc. (“Mid Penn”) (Nasdaq: MPB), is proud to continue its support of the PA Breast Cancer Coalition (“PBCC”) with a $60,000 donation presented during the organization’s annual Pink Fountain Event at the Pennsylvania State Capitol on October 6. Mid Penn Bank President and CEO and PBCC Board Member Rory Ritrievi spoke at the event and presented the donation, made possible through funds raised during the 2026 Mid Penn Bank Celebrity Golf Classic, held July 14-16 in Hershey.


The annual Pink Fountain Event brings together breast cancer survivors, advocates, lawmakers and community members in recognition of Breast Cancer Awareness Month. Each year, the PBCC turns the Capitol fountain pink to honor those affected by breast cancer and raise awareness of the continued need for research, education and support.


“A breast cancer diagnosis can change a life in an instant, and for decades, the PA Breast Cancer Coalition has helped ensure no one has to face that journey alone,” Ritrievi said. “Mid Penn is proud to continue supporting the PBCC’s work to help those affected by breast cancer today while advancing the progress that brings us closer to a future without it.”


The PBCC works to further breast cancer research and provides advocacy and patient resources throughout Pennsylvania. This year, the organization is awarding $500,000 in research grants to Pennsylvania scientists working to advance breast cancer treatment and care. Since its research grant program began, the PBCC has awarded more than $6.6 million to researchers across the state.


Now in its 11th year, the Mid Penn Bank Celebrity Golf Classic brings together celebrity guests, sponsors, volunteers and community partners each summer to raise awareness and funding for breast cancer research, advocacy and care. This year’s event also featured Project Pink, Mid Penn’s initiative with the PBCC, where participants assembled 200 Friends Like Me care packages for Pennsylvanians newly diagnosed with breast cancer. Since its inception in 2016, the Mid Penn Bank Celebrity Golf Classic has raised and contributed $950,000 to PBCC.


### About Mid Penn Bank


Mid Penn Bank, headquartered in Millersburg, Pennsylvania, has been serving the community since 1868. The Bank operates 59 retail locations throughout Pennsylvania and central and southern New Jersey, and has total assets of approximately $7 billion. Mid Penn offers a comprehensive portfolio of financial products and services to meet the banking needs of the communities it serves. To learn more, please visit[www.midpennbank.com](https://www.midpennbank.com/) .
